metric_definition: Mean absolute error (MAE), balanced equally across location/day-or-night groups, then dates and satellite passes; observations within a pass are weighted by footprint area.
observation_scope: Native VIIRS satellite footprints, mainly clear-sky conditions. These are research candidates, separate from the live 40-input model. They do not establish 100 m, cloudy-condition or worldwide accuracy.
